name: smwmusic-chrono-trigger-the-fight-song-for-saving-time-battle
title: Chrono Trigger - The Fight Song for Saving Time 🕛 ~ Battle 1 (Remix)
description:
❝ 𝐖𝐞𝐚𝐩𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐀𝐫𝐞 𝐍𝐨𝐭 𝐌𝐞𝐚𝐧𝐭 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐓𝐚𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐎𝐟 𝐋𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐬. 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐲’𝐫𝐞 𝐌𝐞𝐚𝐧𝐭 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐒𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐦. ❞
ㅤ- Melchior, 1995

Did an arrangement of Battle 1 from Chrono Trigger in memory of Akira Toriyama. Not often I do something like this, but as fan of Chrono Trigger and huge fan of Akira Toriyama's work & art, I thought it'd be great to dedicate this one to him.

Chrono Trigger's Battle theme is one of my favorite battle themes in any RPG

Important:
ㅤ♠ "Bonus End," Yoshi SFX, & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. D Minor (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. C Minor (Custom Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Default Echo Delay, but sacrifices the P-Switch Jingle & @9 is replaced with @0 (Default Echo Delay)
ㅤ2. Decreases Echo Delay (Lower Echo Delay)ㅤ[turned on by default]
